text: Kept PAWL-006 AC6 at checkable: partially rather than promoting it with the others. TestBlockedGateStillProducesEvidence covers the exit code and the attestation, but AC6 also requires the attestation step to run before the gate step, which is a property of the CI job in examples/ and cannot be asserted from inside this repository. Marking it yes would have been the asserted rigour C-1 refuses.
